// UnpackInput attempts to decode the provided call data using contract method definitions.
func (inputChecker *InputChecker) UnpackInput(callData []byte) (any, error) {
	if len(callData) < 4 {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _InputCheckerABI.Methods["anonInput"].ID[:4]) {
		return inputCheckerUnpackInput[InputChecker_AnonInput_Input]("anonInput", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _InputCheckerABI.Methods["anonInputs"].ID[:4]) {
		return inputCheckerUnpackInput[InputChecker_AnonInputs_Input]("anonInputs", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _InputCheckerABI.Methods["mixedInputs"].ID[:4]) {
		return inputCheckerUnpackInput[InputChecker_MixedInputs_Input]("mixedInputs", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _InputCheckerABI.Methods["namedInput"].ID[:4]) {
		return inputCheckerUnpackInput[InputChecker_NamedInput_Input]("namedInput", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _InputCheckerABI.Methods["namedInputs"].ID[:4]) {
		return inputCheckerUnpackInput[InputChecker_NamedInputs_Input]("namedInputs", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _InputCheckerABI.Methods["noInput"].ID[:4]) {
		return inputChecker.NoInput, nil
	}
	return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
}

type inputCheckerEventUnpacker struct {
	id     common.Hash
	unpack func(*types.Log) (any, error)
}

type inputCheckerErrorUnpacker struct {
	id     [4]byte
	unpack func([]byte) (any, error)
}

func inputCheckerMust[T any](val T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return val
}

func inputCheckerConvertType[T any](value any) T {
	return *abi.ConvertType(value, new(T)).(*T)
}

func inputCheckerCallRaw(ctx context.Context, client bind.ContractCaller, addr common.Address, opts *bind.CallOpts, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var callOpts bind.CallOpts
	if opts != nil {
		callOpts = *opts
	}
	callOpts.Context = ctx
	return bind.NewBoundContract(addr, *_InputCheckerABI, client, nil, nil).CallRaw(&callOpts, input)
}

func inputCheckerUnpackInput[T any](name string, callData []byte) (*T, error) {
	method, ok := _InputCheckerABI.Methods[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("method '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(callData) < 4 || !bytes.Equal(callData[:4], method.ID[:4]) {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	arguments, err := method.Inputs.Unpack(callData[4:])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	input := new(T)
	any(input).(interface{ unpack([]any) }).unpack(arguments)
	return input, nil
}

func inputCheckerUnpackEvent[T any](name string, log *types.Log) (*T, error) {
	event, ok := _InputCheckerABI.Events[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("event '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	if log.Topics[0] != event.ID {
		return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
	}
	var values []any
	if len(log.Data) > 0 {
		var err error
		values, err = event.Inputs.Unpack(log.Data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	out := new(T)
	eventData := any(out).(interface {
		unpack([]any)
		setRaw(*types.Log)
	})
	eventData.unpack(values)
	var indexed abi.Arguments
	for _, arg := range event.Inputs {
		if arg.Indexed {
			indexed = append(indexed, arg)
		}
	}
	if err := abi.ParseTopics(out, indexed, log.Topics[1:]); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	eventData.setRaw(log)
	return out, nil
}
